== Summary ==
[[Matthew Reed]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Virginia Beach, Virginia), the photograph on his player card in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #48, p. 78. Crop of the photograph only; the full card is [[:File:Matthew Reed 1999 Young Jedi Worlds player card.jpg]]. Photo: Rich Handley.

== Source ==
* Rich Handley, "[[All Decked Out (Star Wars Insider)|All Decked Out]]", ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #48 (April 2000), p. 78. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-wars-insider-56b702/page/n81/mode/2up ''Star Wars Insider'' 48], Internet Archive. Cropped from the same scan in [https://archive.org/details/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials Star Wars Insider Magazines (1 to 153 + Specials)], file Star Wars Insider 048 (2000), jp2 leaf 0081 (2448×3168), the largest copy of the scan.
* '''Photographer:''' Rich Handley (printed credit "photos by Rich Handley", p. 79).
* '''Date:''' photographed 11–14 November 1999 at [[DecipherCon 1999]]; published April 2000.
* '''Identification:''' the card's printed title, "Matthew Reed".

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/26/Matthew_Reed_DecipherCon_1999_Insider_portrait.jpg Internet Archive item].
